title: Build the calculator with make
description: This Makefile generates parser and lexer sources, then links the calculator.

steps.description: These variables choose GCC, warning and debug flags, and the Flex and math libraries.
The calc target compiles the generated parser and lexer into calc.
Bison generates the parser source and header. Flex generates the lexer source after the header exists.
The clean target removes the executable and generated files.
